normalized.description: Health smoke tests + auto-fix for gbrain installs (and OpenClaw services when present). Run after machine/container restarts or whenever something seems broken. Tests critical services, auto-fixes bounded local issues, and reports worker topology without starting daemons. Extensible via user-defined test scripts in ~/.gbrain/smoke-tests.d/*.sh.
normalized.name: smoke-test
